raw_data_policy: Official EIA downloads are preserved unmodified with SHA-256 hashes in load-shape/coverage.json.
publication_rules: Every dashboard claim resolves to one or more verified source IDs.
Every current project status includes an evidence date.
Every MW value includes a capacity type.
Null and missing are never rendered as zero.
Draft, scenario, planned, permitted, construction, and operating are never collapsed.
Approximate geometry is never used for parcel, engineering, or environmental conclusions.
Security-sensitive and CEII detail is not reconstructed or exposed.
